source: Who's On First (whosonfirst-data-admin-us latest dist; Orleans downloaded 2026-10-29, Jefferson 2026-11-01), current polygon geometries whose label point is inside the metro (config/metro-bounds/new-orleans.json). Orleans Parish: placetype neighbourhood, 71 geometries from the City of New Orleans GIS (nolagis, the city's official neighbourhood outlines) and 2 from Mapzen (CC0); a duplicate Zetashapes 'East Carrollton' left out; simplified to about 10 m. Jefferson Parish (D-555): its one polygon neighbourhood (Place de Concorde, Zetashapes) plus its 21 localities (Metairie, Kenner, Gretna, Harahan, Marrero and the rest, Quattroshapes) as the coarser fallback, the smallest outline winning (WOF's other Jefferson neighbourhoods are points only); simplified to about 20 m. None from OpenStreetMap.
